description: Post-screen bulk backlog ordering, frozen before raw SAP batch triage. Heuristic only; does not establish eclipse reality, target attribution, novelty, or orbital solution.
inclusion: All fold flags, plus unflagged targets with max(P.z,P2.z)>=4 as near flags. All 1924 targets remain in all-outcomes.json regardless of queue membership.
raw_window: Use best-z fold ephemeris P or P2 to predict each cached-sector window; quality-zero SAP, sector median normalized, core +/-duration/2, sidebands 1–2.5 durations on each side.
isolated_stat: Positive median core depth, core below both sidebands, local SNR>=5, and absolute difference of sideband medians < 0.7 of core depth; requires >=3 core and >=4 points in each sideband. This is a ranking aid, not an event classification.
tiers: repeat_stat: >=2 isolated_stat windows at distinct cycles
ambiguous_raw: positive local SNR>=5 in a measured window but no isolated_stat
screen_only: flag without positive local raw SNR>=5
sort: Tier order, then descending max z, then ascending TIC. Known catalogue/history labels retained and do not erase rows.
